title: Seldon TFM family: Seldon-Mini, Seldon and Seldon+
abstract: arXiv:2611.32257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Seldon, a family of tabular foundation models. Our classifier Seldon+ ranks first among 15 models on TabBench, our benchmark of 124 classification datasets, and on its variant with missing values. In our own runs of public benchmarks, it also ranks first on BeyondArena IID classification and TabBench-Bio, and second on TabArena classification. The open-weight models Seldon-Mini (27M parameters) and Seldon (213M parameters) both lie on the TabArena Pareto front of Elo against inference time: no entry is both more accurate and faster. On TabArena, Seldon ranks fourth and Seldon-Mini seventh among 109 leaderboard entries, and on the IID track of BeyondArena, Seldon ranks second among 42 entries. Seldon-Mini and Seldon handle both classification and regression, use an architecture similar to those of Kumo-Tabular, TabFM and TabPFN-3.5, and are trained on synthetic tables only.

translated_title: Seldon 表格基础模型家族：Seldon-Mini、Seldon 与 Seldon+
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了 Seldon，一个表格基础模型家族。我们的分类器 Seldon+ 在 TabBench（我们构建的包含 124 个分类数据集的基准测试）及其含缺失值的变体上，在 15 个模型中排名第一。在我们自行运行的公开基准测试中，它还在 BeyondArena IID 分类和 TabBench-Bio 上排名第一，在 TabArena 分类任务上排名第二。开源权重模型 Seldon-Mini（2700 万参数）和 Seldon（2.13 亿参数）均位于 TabArena 上 Elo 得分与推理时间的帕累托前沿：没有任何模型能够同时做到更准确且更快速。在 TabArena 的 109 个排行榜条目中，Seldon 排名第四，Seldon-Mini 排名第七；在 BeyondArena 的 IID 赛道上，Seldon 在 42 个条目中排名第二。Seldon-Mini 和 Seldon 同时支持分类与回归任务，采用与 Kumo-Tabular、TabFM 和 TabPFN-3.5 类似的架构，并且仅使用合成表格数据进行训练。
tldr: Seldon 表格基础模型家族仅用合成数据训练，在多项表格基准测试中名列前茅，其开源模型 Seldon-Mini 和 Seldon 同时支持分类与回归，并在准确性与推理速度的权衡上处于帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: The Seldon family of tabular foundation models, trained solely on synthetic data, achieves top rankings across multiple benchmarks, with open-weight models Seldon-Mini and Seldon handling both classification and regression while lying on the Pareto front of accuracy versus inference time.
